title.narrative: UNESCO–Nestlé Alliance – Because Youth Matter - Going Global

description.narrative: Following the successful implementation of the pilot "Because Youth Matter - Impulso Joven" project implemented in Latin America, UNESCO and Nestlé are scaling up their collaboration for a Global Youth Grant Scheme implemented worldwide across all regions. "Youth Impact: Because You Matter" will support 100 youth-led initiatives with social impact by providing young individuals, youth-led organizations, enterprises, associations, or networks with grants; The project's capacity-building component will strengthen grantee capacities as young leaders and change-makers actively engaged in the development of their communities, while also aiming to address challenges affecting youth employability and entrepreneurship.
